subject: cult-af-bs
title: CULT.AF.BS.------AFL.
description: Chart on book p. 477 (TRF(II)-13). CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis) is the subject; AFL (affinity alignment) is the partner. From the subject: RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits), T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From RT-INT-TR: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From SOC-RT-DY: EXP-DT (expansion dictates). From T-C-IMP: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From PROG-CONT: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From SPT-DY: PER-DY (perception dynamics). From PER-DY: MOT-DY. From MOT-DY: POST (postulation).
